interface.name: kywc_capture_manager_v1

description.summary: manager to inform clients and begin get capturing

interface.description: This object is a manager which offers requests to start capturing from a source.

request.name: capture_output
request.description: Capture the next frame of an entire output.

request.name: capture_workspace
request.description: Capture the next frame of an entire workspace in one output.

request.name: capture_toplevel
request.description: Capture the next frame of an entire toplevel.

request.name: capture_cursor
request.description: Capture the cursor of the seat and frame.

request.name: destroy
request.description: All objects created by the manager will still remain valid, until their appropriate destroy request has been called.

request.name: destroy

description.summary: delete this object, used or not

request.description: Destroys the frame. This request can be sent at any time by the client.

event.name: failed
event.description: This event indicates that the attempted frame copy has failed. After receiving this event, the client should destroy the object.

event.name: cancelled
event.description: Sent if the compositor cancels the frame because the source has gone. Upon receiving this event, the client should destroy this object.

event.name: buffer
event.description: Provides information about buffer parameters that need to be used for this frame.

request.name: release_buffer
request.description: Mark the buffer is not used by client. This request is sent after buffer event.

arg.name: want_buffer
arg.summary: request send buffer event when buffer is changed

event.name: buffer_with_plane
event.description: Provides information about buffer parameters with the plane index that need to be used for this frame.

description.summary: all buffer parameters have been sent

interface.name: kywc_capture_cursor_v1
interface.description: When the seat or frame is destroyed, this object becomes inert.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroys the object. This request can be sent at any time by the client.

event.name: enter
event.description:
This event indicates that when a cursor enters the frame. It shall be generated before the "position" and "hotspot" events.
If the pointer object referenced by the seat does not exist, this event will not be triggered.

event.name: leave
event.description:
This event indicates that when a cursor leaves the frame. No "position" or "hotspot" event is generated for the cursor until the cursor enters the frame again.
If the pointer object referenced by the seat is removed, this event will be sent.

event.name: position
event.description:
This event informs the cursor position. The given position is relative to the frame's top left corner in transformed buffer pixel coordinates.
Note, if the frame parameter is set to null in the capture_cursor request, the given position coordinates are global.

event.name: hotspot
event.description:
This event informs the cursor hotspot. The hotspot describes the offset between the cursor image and the position of the input device.
The parameters x and y represent the offset of the new hotspot relative to the origin of the cursor image, which is typically the top-left corner of the image.
